interview:
name: interview
description: Ask interactive questions to gather requirements, preferences, or decisions before building something
argument-hint: <topic to discuss>
prime:
name: prime
description: Cold-start a session — read handoff, git log, and Key Files for immediate context
argument-hint: [context]
create-component:
description: Create a new agent, command, or skill following established conventions
argument-hint: [agent|command|skill] [name] [description]
evolve:
description: Close out a completed delivery cycle — archive the drained backlog/TODOs (history-preserving), then regenerate the plan from production evidence into a fresh cycle N+1 backlog
argument-hint: "[--force] [--dry-run] [cycle label]"
route:
name: route
description: Assess a request's scale and route it to the right pipeline depth — bugfix→/do, feature→/todo, epic→full planning. The front door of the build loop.
argument-hint: [what you want to build or change]
review-security:
description: Audit code for OWASP compliance, vulnerabilities, secrets, and threat surface
argument-hint: [file path, PR number, git diff range, or directory]
create-project-architecture:
description: Create a technical architecture document with tech stack decisions, ADRs, and system design
argument-hint: [project name or prd path] [--yolo]
investigate:
description: Investigate a bug with root cause analysis before applying fixes
argument-hint: [error message, file path, or "last failure"]
create-new-project:
description: Initialize a new project — scaffolds the docs tree and walks the full planning pipeline to implementation-ready
argument-hint: "[project name] [--yolo]"
brainstorm:
description: Run a guided brainstorming session to explore the problem space and surface solution ideas
argument-hint: [topic or problem statement]
todo:
description: Create an execution-ready TODO checklist with AC, file lists, research, and wave plan
argument-hint: [task description, file path, or module name]
create-project-epics:
description: Break requirements into epics and stories for implementation
argument-hint: [project name or architecture path] [--yolo]
review-status:
description: Show project status — parse TODO files, display progress, generate HTML dashboard
argument-hint: [--text-only to skip HTML generation]
do:
description: Execute a single task — from conversation context, a TODO story, or ad-hoc request
argument-hint: "[story ID | task description] [--e2e] [--delegate]"
review-update-docs:
description: Apply documentation fixes — update planning docs to match actual implementation
argument-hint: [scope: all | architecture | epics | prd]
run-tests:
description: Execute a manual/E2E testing checklist with parallel agents, screenshots, and TODO updates — plus canary mode (--baseline / --compare) for post-deploy golden-signal monitoring
argument-hint: [testing TODO file] [--baseline | --compare {baseline.json}] [--tolerance N]
create-project-epics-todo:
description: Create a detailed story-level implementation checklist for a single epic
argument-hint: [epic number or "all"] [--yolo]
retro:
description: Run a retrospective after completing an epic — code-review pass first, then analyze what worked, what didn't, extract patterns
argument-hint: [epic name or number] [--skip-review]
review-code-review:
description: Review code changes against architecture standards, security best practices, and project conventions
argument-hint: [file path, PR number, or git diff range]
review-timeline: description: "Generate or update work/timeline.md with weekly commit history"
triage:
description: Triage a signal-intake file into the backlog — classify each signal (promote / defer / kill / research), auto-deciding mechanical calls and interviewing only the judgment calls
argument-hint: [optional intake file path | {YYYY-MM-DD} | --dry-run]
run-todo:
description: Execute an entire TODO end-to-end using wave-based parallel agents with AC gates and auto-commits
argument-hint: "[path to TODO file] [--e2e] [--no-delegate]"
research:
description: Research and validate market, technical, or domain assumptions
argument-hint: [research topic or question]
review-optimize-agents:
description: Re-align agents, skills, and memory with the actual codebase during implementation
argument-hint: "[--dry-run | --fix | --report-only]"
review-memory-health: description: Run extract (opt-in) + lint + decay health check on the memory system
onboard:
description: Reverse-engineer the doc chain from an existing codebase — brownfield analog of /create:new-project
argument-hint: "[--yolo]"
review-evolve-skills:
description: Self-improving skills — mine this repo's own signals into skill CREATE/IMPROVE proposals, validate them with a differential eval, and apply on confirm
argument-hint: "[--create-only | --improve-only] [--auto] [--apply <skill-name>] [--since YYYY-MM-DD]"
listen:
description: Aggregate post-MVP signals (git, telemetry, agent-updates, backlog drift, external) into a dated intake file
argument-hint: [optional --since {YYYY-MM-DD} | "14d" | source filter]
review-memory-defrag: description: Identify memory store overlap clusters and walk the user through merge / split / cross-ref proposals
review-qa:
description: Generate automated tests for existing code using acceptance criteria from stories
argument-hint: [story number, file path, or module name]
create-project-design:
description: Create UX design artifacts — spec, wireframes, themes, and mock layout
argument-hint: [project name or prd path] [--yolo]
create-module:
description: Scaffold a new module — brainstorm, decide, document, plan, and generate its TODO
argument-hint: [module description]
review-promote-memories: description: Surface high-confidence memory concepts for promotion into templates, skills, and agents
create-project-requirements:
description: Create a Product Requirements Document (PRD) with functional and non-functional requirements
argument-hint: [project name or project-brief path] [--yolo]
review-personalize:
description: Give agents names, personas, and soul-level identity. Works before or after /specialize.
argument-hint: "[agent name | --all]"
review-feedback:
description: Capture a template-performance feedback report (telemetry digest + agent self-review) for this project
argument-hint: "[--quiet]"
end:
name: end
description: Save session context for continuing work in a new conversation
argument-hint: [optional notes]
review-check-readiness: description: Validate that all planning docs are complete and consistent before implementation
remember:
description: Capture a conversational insight to the daily log for memory acquisition
argument-hint: [what to remember — a decision, insight, or discovery]
review-check-templates: description: Audit .claude/ system health — orphaned agents, unused skills, missing hooks, broken wiring
create-project-todo:
description: Create master project implementation index with phase tracking and epic status
argument-hint: [project name] [--yolo]
review-organize: description: Organize plan files and verification screenshots into date folders
review-check-sync:
description: Detect documentation drift after implementation — flags docs that are out of sync with code
argument-hint: [scope: all | architecture | stories | prd]
review-changelog:
description: Generate a changelog from completed stories and git history
argument-hint: [version or date range — e.g., "v1.0" or "2026-01-01..2026-02-01"]
review-optimize-backlog: description: Analyze backlog for dependency optimization, critical path, and parallel workstreams
create-project-brief:
description: Create a project brief capturing strategic vision and project scope
argument-hint: [project name or description]
sweep:
description: Autonomous post-work maintenance sweep — code review → retro (+ doc-drift check) → implement recommendations → promote → optimize agents → defrag → health (memory + .claude/ templates audit) → timeline refresh. One command, auto-approved, report at end.
argument-hint: "[PR range / epic names — e.g. '109-128' or 'Auth,Billing,Search'] [--review-scope high-risk|systemic|all] [--gated] [--skip 1,4]"
learning-intake:
description: Capture selected toolkit lessons and inspect or explicitly deliver retained learning requests
argument-hint: "[init | capture | status | submit | reconcile | refresh | recover] [validated input path or occurrence ID]"
